title: Local constancy on balls for currents killing (D_j a) dx (Steps 1, 3–5 of Simon 2.34)
statement: Let m ∈ ℕ, n = m + 1, U ⊆ ℝⁿ open and T ∈ D_n(U), and assume T(ω) = 0 whenever ω ∈ Dⁿ(U) satisfies ω(x)(e_1,…,e_n) = D_j a(x) for all x ∈ ℝⁿ, for some j ∈ {1,…,n} and some C^∞ compactly supported a : ℝⁿ → ℝ with spt a ⊆ U. Then for every x₀ ∈ U there are r > 0 with B_r(x₀) ⊆ U and c ∈ ℝ such that T(ω) = c ∫ ω(x)(e_1,…,e_n) dLⁿ(x) for every ω ∈ Dⁿ(U) with spt ω ⊆ B_r(x₀).
lean_statement: ∀ (m : ℕ) (U : Set (Eucl (m + 1))), IsOpen U → ∀ T : GeometricCurrentOn U (m + 1), (∀ (a : Eucl (m + 1) → ℝ), ContDiff ℝ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) a → HasCompactSupport a → tsupport a ⊆ U → ∀ (j : Fin (m + 1)) (ω : TestFormOn U (m + 1)), (∀ x, (ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl (m + 1)) (m + 1)) x (fun i => EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ)) = fderiv ℝ a x (EuclideanSpace.single j (1 : ℝ))) → T ω = 0) → ∀ x₀ ∈ U, ∃ r : ℝ, 0 < r ∧ ball x₀ r ⊆ U ∧ ∃ c : ℝ, ∀ ω : TestFormOn U (m + 1), tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl (m + 1)) (m + 1)) ⊆ ball x₀ r → T ω = c * ∫ x, (ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl (m + 1)) (m + 1)) x (fun i => EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ)) ∂volume
